overall_assessment: All 28 courses were reviewed: no personal-data leaks, residual administrative dates, substantive content loss or structure loss were confirmed in the packet; staff names, including the free-text lecturer line, are correctly removed while reference authors and subject matter remain. The seven suspects' pre-pass flags are false alarms: high removed shares reflect legitimate removals from short plans, name_like flags reflect reference names/titles and capitalized programme or subject terms, and the admin_date flag concerns retained government-document dating, with a law date visible in the removed-span context. The remaining defect is minor grammatical damage after date removal in 15 courses, including 14 of the 21 random controls, showing a recurring template issue rather than a privacy failure.

findings.evidence: Gjeldende litteraturliste for finner du i Leganto
findings.description: Removing semester-year tokens from the Leganto notice leaves a dangling preposition in 14 random controls: 'Gjeldende litteraturliste for finner du i Leganto'. The same date-token-only removal problem appears once in running prose in Geografi: removing 2007/2008 leaves 'hver ekskursjon vil i koste om lag NOK 200 per student'. Removing these administrative dates is correct, but leaving half-removed phrases violates the text-corruption rubric; this is cosmetic grammatical damage, with the reading-list destination and excursion price preserved.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R runs .anon_hiof() before .anon_generic(); the HiOF handler has no rewrite for the dated Leganto template, and the generic season/year rules and .drop_academic_year() delete date tokens without handling dependent prepositions. This leaves 'for' or 'i' attached to the following verb.
findings.suggested_fix: Before generic date removal, add a narrowly scoped rewrite in .anon_hiof() for the complete 'Gjeldende litteraturliste for <semester-year> finner du i Leganto' template, accepting both year-season and season-year order, to 'Gjeldende litteraturliste finner du i Leganto'. Likewise, rewrite the observed 'vil i <consecutive academic-year range> koste' construction to 'vil koste' when removing its administrative range; avoid blanket deletion of prepositions elsewhere. Add regression cases for both constructions while preserving season words without years and government-document dates.
